data.title: House Bill 10858, Volume I-B: the three project lists, second reading
data.notes: Page numbers are positions in this file, not the page numbers shown on the pages. It lists farm-to-market roads (pages 667–726), health facilities (877–893) and irrigation projects (896–941), each with its totals. It also carries DPWH's section of the bill, with the department's total new appropriations. The DPWH project list and its program totals are in Volume I-C. The three lists were read from this copy. The third-reading copy publishes the same pages word for word, so rows and totals link there.
